analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 39.5 attempts to exit oversold territory, but MACD histogram at -0.4815 is still improving in negative territory, signaling a weak reversal. The price remains in an accumulation phase with low volume (vol_ratio 0.70) for 5 consecutive days. Weekly RSI at 44.3 stays neutral. ADX at 32.9 indicates a clear trend, but the -DI (35.8) is stronger than +DI (18.0), suggesting lingering downward pressure. The 4-hour RSI at 41.5 mirrors the daily neutral stance. Overall, insufficient conviction for a directional move, hence a wait-and-see approach.
